146484 / 146484S: Cortech Radial Rocker
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-146484-radial-rocker-chair
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/seating/radial-rocker/
Spec sheet: 146484
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Radial Rocker Chair – 146484 / 146484S
Current H1: Cortech Radial Rocker - Rocking Chair - One-Piece Rotationally Molded Polyethylene - Model 146484
Subtitle: One-Piece Molded Rocking Chair with a Smooth 56° Rocking Radius and an Optional Ballast Door
Current subtitle: Cortech USA 146484 Radial Rocker Chair
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Radial Rocker Chair is a molded rocking chair for behavioral healthcare and correctional facilities. Its gentle, controlled rocking motion helps users relax, and its low center of gravity keeps the chair stable and the motion smooth.
The rocker is rotationally molded in one piece from high impact “no break” polyethylene, with no steel or wood components. It weighs 60 lbs unfilled, and the 146484S has a ballast door for adding sandbags on site. The Radial Rocker is rated for outdoor use.
Material: One-piece rotationally molded high impact “no break” polyethylene; no steel or wood components
Dimensions: 30”W×45”D×40”H
Weight: 60 lbs unfilled
Rocking Radius: 56°
Stability: Lower center of gravity improves stability and creates a smoother sway
Ballast Door: The 146484S has a ballast door for adding sandbags on site; it closes with tamper-resistant screws. Do not use loose sand
Outdoor Use: Rated for outdoor use and UV stabilized
Antimicrobial Testing: Tested to ISO 22196, showing a greater than 99% reduction in bacteria
Flammability Standards: Flame retardant; passes California Technical Bulletin 133 and UL 94 HB
Environmental Certification: GREENGUARD Gold
Easy Cleaning: Sound dampening, and easy to clean, sanitize, and maintain
Colors: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Canvas, Claylight, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Moss, Overcast, Sand, Seagrass, Slate Blue, Stone Gray, or Tide (custom colors available on request)
Warranty: Lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
146484 – Standard: Without access door
146484S – With Access Door: Ballast door for adding sandbags on site
Installation and Options
Weighting: Add sandbags through the ballast door on the 146484S; do not use loose sand. Hardware bit size is T27
[H2] Applications
The Radial Rocker suits calming spaces where a safe rocking chair helps users relax.
Typical applications include:
Lounges and dayrooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Dayrooms in correctional facilities and juvenile detention centers
Residential treatment centers and other therapeutic settings
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture and Prison and Detention Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Cortech Seating
Cortech seating is molded for dayrooms, lounges, dining areas, and patient rooms in behavioral healthcare and correctional facilities, where chairs are used hard every day and must be difficult to break or tamper with.
Cortech seating includes:
Stacking Chairs: The Razorback injection molded stack chair
Lounge and Group Seating: The Sabre Lounge Chair and the Sentinel Arm and Armless Chairs, which stand alone or bolt together
Rocking Chairs: The Radial Rocker
Summit Series: Guest chairs, accent chairs, lounge chairs, and stools, with an optional Veldura soft-touch finish
Endurance Series: Crew chairs, benches, and floor mounted stools
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (59 characters): Cortech Radial Rocker Chair - 146484 / 146484S at Anchortex
Meta description (156 characters): Shop the Cortech Radial Rocker Chair. A one-piece molded rocking chair with a smooth 56° rocking radius and an optional ballast door, rated for outdoor use.
Notes and Questions
Series section: "About Cortech Seating" is a new section for the Razorback, Sabre, Sentinel, and Radial Rocker pages. It is the same on each of these pages.
H1: Cortech calls it the Radial Rocker. I used "Radial Rocker Chair," took out "Rocking Chair," "One-Piece Rotationally Molded Polyethylene," and "Model," and added the 146484S.
Weight: your variant is set to 70 lbs. The Cortech spec sheet says 60 lbs unfilled, so I used 60 lbs unfilled.
Warranty: your current page says 10-year warranty. The Cortech spec sheet says lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects, so I used that.
Colors: your current page lists 7 colors, including "Slated Blue." The Cortech spec sheet lists 18, so I used the Cortech list.
Seat height: your current page says 17” seat height. The Cortech spec sheet does not give a seat height, so I left it out.
Static load: your current page says 1,500 lb static load. The Cortech spec sheet does not give a static load, so I left it out.
GREENGUARD Gold: this comes from the Cortech web page. The spec sheet does not mention it.
Outdoor use: the FAQ on the Cortech product page says the Radial Rocker is rated for outdoor use and UV stabilized, so I added it to the description.
Product images: the page has five images. The last one is the older Cortech color chart with 12 colors. The Cortech product page has photos of this chair in all 18 colors. Would you like me to add them, and replace the chart with the 18-color chart?
